headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank Posts 26% Profit Rise on Improved Asset Quality
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 26% surge in net profit for the second quarter, driven by strengthening asset quality across its loan book.
why: Kotak Mahindra Bank is one of India's premier private-sector lenders, offering insight into credit growth and credit quality in the Indian financial sector.

impacts.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited
impacts.why: Strong earnings expansion and improving loan health bolster capital return prospects.
